groups.title: Use
items: For one option in a mutually exclusive choice set.
Keep the label visible and outcome-based.
Use support text when the option changes policy, cost, or operational scope.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use for independent boolean choices.
Do not hide the parent question in the option.
Do not implement group validation or layout inside the atomic component.

groups.title: Review
items: Confirm the parent pattern owns group semantics.
Check focus, checked state, disabled, and error association.
Verify support text wraps across small viewports.
